title: Weather Dial — Tiny City Climate Toy

checks.name: JavaScript syntax
checks.details: app.js parses with no syntax errors.

checks.name: Static acceptance and local-only assets
checks.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import re; files={p.name:p.read_text() for p in Path('.').iterdir() if p.is_file()}; html,js=files['index.html'],files['app.js']; assert '<canvas' in html and 'href=\"styles.css\"' in html; assert 'prefers-reduced-motion' in js and 'SEED0' in js"
checks.details: Required files, canvas, local CSS/JS, seed, and reduced-motion handling are present. No remote src/href imports.

checks.name: City systems and interaction hooks
checks.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import re; js=Path('app.js').read_text(); names=re.findall(r'name: \"([^\"]+)\"', js); buildings=[n for n in names if n not in ['Summer shower','Autumn gale','Winter night','Spring sunrise']]; assert len(buildings)>=12; assert 'hitCloud' in js and 'gusts' in js and 'showCard' in js"
checks.details: Fourteen named buildings plus gust painting, cloud bursts, building cards, and preset/pause/reset key handlers are in source.

checks.name: Remote URL scan of runtime files
checks.command:
python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import re; hits=[];
[hits.extend((p.name,m.group(0)) for m in re.finditer(r'https?://[^\"\\')\s]+', p.read_text())) for p in Path('.').iterdir() if p.suffix in {'.html','.js','.css','.md'}]; assert hits==[('app.js','http://www.w3.org/2000/svg')]"
checks.details: HTML, JS, CSS, and README contain no CDN or network URLs. The only http match is the SVG namespace in createElementNS.

summary: A direct-open isometric city diorama with a brass weather console. Wind, temperature, precipitation, clock, and season drive buildings, traffic, people, trees, and particles. An attract weather story runs on load; drag gusts, cloud seeding, building cards, and four presets work from local files.
